name: A Time of Life
source:
Set in the Rebuild of Evangelion universe, "A Time of Life" helps bridge a critical divide between Evangelion 2.22 You Can (Not) Advance and Evangelion 3.33 You Can (Not) Redo. Told from the perspective of Mari Illustrious Makinami.

[Edited from [url=http://sonofcarnelian.tumblr.com/post/124344089899/im-beyond-excited-that-i-can-finally-announce-the]Son of Carnelian[/url]]
